title: Import a real GitHub Project view
description: Read an accessible Project view with the selected account, verify mapped filters, and discard the unsaved team draft.

gateway-access.intent: A real provider import returns its Project catalog and preserves configuration without creating work.

open-prs.intent: The operator can configure PR sources from the connected dashboard.

wait-panel.intent: Source authoring remains accessible independently of active runs.

open-rules.intent: Team and rule configuration is available to the authorized operator.

open-team.intent: A new team draft can inspect sources before any policy is saved.

choose-account.intent: Project reads use the explicitly selected GitHub account.

enter-url.intent: The saved-view URL identifies the Project scope the operator intends to import.

import.intent: Import requests real provider metadata without saving a broader source.

access-error.intent: The imported view retains provider filter terms and exposes their mapped predicates.

show-error.intent: The original view filters are readable in the unsaved source draft.

capture.intent: The screenshot records successfully imported provider filters before any team is saved.

close-draft.intent: Discard the unsaved validation draft without modifying existing teams.
